title: Writing / Style / Ellipses
slide_intent: Control the spacing of a trailing thought so readers can distinguish a pause from a sentence boundary.
strategic_value: A small paired example can help Duolingo retain a conversational rhythm without inconsistent punctuation.
demonstration: Two preferred and two rejected lines compare ellipsis spacing within a sentence and before a new sentence.
practical_value: Check whether the ellipsis continues the sentence or ends it before adding a space.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples contrast an internal pause with an ellipsis followed by a new sentence.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use ellipses infrequently; put no space on either side within a sentence, but add a following space when the ellipsis ends the sentence.

ingredient.name: Ellipses convention
ingredient.role: Readers can distinguish a pause from a sentence boundary.
ingredient.application: Use ellipses infrequently; put no space on either side within a sentence, but add a following space when the ellipsis ends the sentence.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
